title: MIVA gains ground and grace with her transformative new single, “Traction”
htmlContent: MIVA is an independent producer, songwriter, and artist from Montreal. With the release of "Traction," she is ready to start the next chapter of her life. This soulful piece, which mixes genres, feels personal. The song is a testament to her ongoing journey through sincerity, healing, and mental renewal, an emotional evolution that she translates into sound with striking honesty. MIVA isn't just getting her bearings with "Traction," but she's claiming solid ground. https://open.spotify.com/track/3vfhV1bbjkExruyFmICWSO "Traction" starts like a confession, but it's told with steady hands. MIVA leans into the quiet tension between not believing in yourself and believing in yourself, letting listeners see a mind fighting its way to clarity. Her voice has a warmth that comes from having lived. It's rough around the edges from experience, but the light of a new goal polishes it. MIVA combines the soft sounds of R&B, the deep emotional sounds of jazz, and the hard-hitting sounds of hip-hop. The trumpets are loud and cinematic, cutting through the music like a second narrator. They echo her rise, her bravery, and her refusal to hide her flaws. These brass lines don't just hold the track up, but they also lift it, giving "Traction" a sense of movement that fits its name. MIVA doesn't shy away from the tough parts of healing or hide them. Instead, she turns her pain into music, turning her inner battles into something intense and beautiful to listen to. It's a new life set to music, planned, measured, and deeply felt. For an artist who isn't afraid to be honest, the single is a big step forward. It reminds people that every step they take toward themselves is worth celebrating. Follow MIVA on Instagram
